g.text: The tower: six rings, seven disks, the terminal
Ring 0 stands on the transfer ring, 3.06 km above the summit:
150 m wide and 20.5 km round at mid-width.
Air 8.9 °C, steady day and night; oxygen like 2,450 m on
Earth, so it is open to everyone.
Two storeys (9 m and 6 m) under a park. It holds the base
programme (6 km²), so the ground between the legs stays open.
The six gates, where the legs arrive, divide it into six
quarters of 3.4 km. The frame's 24 nodes per level stand at
the outer edge (grey diamonds), 853 m apart at mid-width.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: The six gates and quarters; Quarter 1 is drawn in detail on the next sheets
Summit port · ring 0 · design proposal (artistic), structure informed by the tower study's hand sizing · 28 September 2026
